verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents case assignment to agents and filtering by assignee and case stage. Reviewers record structured case decisions ('no risk detected', 'risk detected – accepted/offboard'), and an API endpoint returns the audit log trail for a case. Escalation is only evidenced as AI agents automatically escalating high-risk or complex cases to humans, not a configurable human-to-human escalation workflow. missing for 10: SLA or due-date tracking on cases, human escalation routing between reviewer tiers, evidence that the audit trail captures who approved and their rationale/notes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
